definition_en: To take liquid into your mouth and swallow it.

zhongkao.sentence: You should drink plenty of water after exercising.
zhongkao.translation: 运动后你应该喝大量的水。

grade10.sentence: It is socially unacceptable to drink and drive because it endangers lives.
grade10.translation: 酒后驾车在社会上是不可接受的，因为它危及生命。

definition_en: The kind of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.

zhongkao.sentence: A healthy diet includes lots of fruit and vegetables.
zhongkao.translation: 健康的饮食包括大量的水果和蔬菜。

grade10.sentence: Doctors suggest that a balanced diet combined with regular physical activity is the key to longevity.
grade10.translation: 医生建议，均衡的饮食结合规律的体育活动是长寿的关键。

definition_en: To put food into your mouth and chew and swallow it.

zhongkao.sentence: We usually eat lunch at school at 12 o'clock.
zhongkao.translation: 我们要通常在12点在学校吃午饭。

grade10.sentence: It is important not to eat in a rush, as digestion begins in the mouth.
grade10.translation: 不要匆忙进食很重要，因为消化是从口腔开始的。

definition_en: To bite and grind food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

zhongkao.sentence: The old man can't chew hard food because of his teeth.
zhongkao.translation: 因为牙齿的原因，这位老人不能咀嚼硬的食物。

grade10.sentence: You should chew your food slowly to aid digestion and prevent stomach problems.
grade10.translation: 你应该细嚼慢咽以帮助消化并预防胃病。

definition_en: Unable to find one's way; not known where something is.

zhongkao.sentence: I lost my keys yesterday and couldn't open the door.
zhongkao.translation: 我昨天丢了钥匙，打不开门。

grade10.sentence: Feeling completely lost in the complex lecture, the student decided to ask the professor for help afterwards.
grade10.translation: 在那堂复杂的讲座中感到完全迷失了方向，这就学生决定课后向教授寻求帮助。

definition_en: A measure of how heavy a person or object is.

zhongkao.sentence: He wants to lose weight, so he runs every morning.
zhongkao.translation: 他想减肥，所以他每天早上跑步。

grade10.sentence: The sheer weight of the responsibility made him feel anxious about the project.
grade10.translation: 沉重的责任感让他对这个项目感到焦虑。

definition_en: Physical activity done to keep your body healthy and strong.

zhongkao.sentence: Doing morning exercises is good for your health.
zhongkao.translation: 做早操对你的健康有好处。

grade10.sentence: Regular exercise not only improves physical fitness but also boosts mental well-being.
grade10.translation: 规律的锻炼不仅能改善身体素质，还能提升心理健康。

definition_en: To go to see a person or a place for a period of time.

zhongkao.sentence: We are planning to visit the Great Wall next summer vacation.
zhongkao.translation: 我们计划明年暑假去参观长城。

grade10.sentence: The President is scheduled to visit several European countries to strengthen diplomatic ties.
grade10.translation: 总统计划访问几个欧洲国家以加强外交关系。

definition_en: A large shop that sells food, drinks, and goods for the home.

zhongkao.sentence: My mother is buying some fruit and vegetables at the supermarket.
zhongkao.translation: 我妈妈正在超市买一些水果和蔬菜。

grade10.sentence: The dominance of large chain supermarkets has made it difficult for small local grocers to survive.
grade10.translation: 大型连锁超市的主导地位使得当地的小杂货店难以生存。

definition_en: A room or building equipped for physical exercise.

zhongkao.sentence: We usually have PE classes in the school gym when it rains.
zhongkao.translation: 下雨的时候我们通常在学校体育馆上体育课。

grade10.sentence: She signed up for a membership at the local gym to access the advanced weightlifting equipment.
grade10.translation: 她在当地健身房注册了会员，以便使用先进的举重设备。

definition_en: A place where you can buy things; to visit places to buy goods.

zhongkao.sentence: I need to go to the shop to buy some milk and bread.
zhongkao.translation: 我需要去商店买些牛奶和面包。

grade10.sentence: Many people prefer to shop online during the holidays to avoid the crowded malls.
grade10.translation: 许多人喜欢在假期网购，以避开拥挤的商场。

definition_en: To keep something for future use; a large shop selling various goods.

zhongkao.sentence: My mother works at a department store in the city center.
zhongkao.translation: 我妈妈在市中心的百货商店工作。

grade10.sentence: Camels store fat in their humps, which allows them to survive for long periods without food.
grade10.translation: 骆驼在驼峰里储存脂肪，这使它们能够在没有食物的情况下生存很长时间。

definition_en: To move the top part of the body in a particular direction; thin and healthy.

zhongkao.sentence: Please do not lean against the door while the bus is moving.
zhongkao.translation: 公共汽车行驶时请不要倚靠车门。

grade10.sentence: The runner had a lean and muscular build from years of intense training.
grade10.translation: 经过多年的高强度训练，这位赛跑运动员拥有精瘦且肌肉发达的体格。

definition_en: An advantage or profit gained from something; to be useful or helpful.

zhongkao.sentence: Doing morning exercises is of great benefit to our health.
zhongkao.translation: 做早操对我们的健康大有裨益。

grade10.sentence: Students will benefit from the new library facilities, which provide a quiet environment for study.
grade10.translation: 学生们将受益于新的图书馆设施，那里提供了安静的学习环境。

definition_en: To be of the right size or shape; healthy and strong.

zhongkao.sentence: This coat fits you perfectly; you look great in it.
zhongkao.translation: 这件外套非常合身，你穿上它看起来很棒。

grade10.sentence: He maintains a strict diet and workout routine to keep fit for the upcoming basketball season.
grade10.translation: 他保持严格的饮食和锻炼习惯，以便为即将到来的篮球赛季保持健康体魄。

definition_en: In good physical or mental condition; beneficial to one's health.

zhongkao.sentence: Eating vegetables and fruit every day helps keep us healthy.
zhongkao.translation: 每天吃蔬菜和水果有助于我们保持健康。

grade10.sentence: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle requires a balance between study, exercise, and rest.
grade10.translation: 保持健康的生活方式需要在学习、运动和休息之间取得平衡。

definition_en: Happening, done, or produced every day.

zhongkao.sentence: Reading books is an important part of my daily life.
zhongkao.translation: 读书是我日常生活的重要组成部分。

grade10.sentence: The daily routine of a high school student can be quite stressful during exam periods.
grade10.translation: 在考试期间，高中生的日常生活可能会非常有压力。

definition_en: Happening or done once a week or every week.

zhongkao.sentence: We usually have a weekly class meeting on Friday afternoon.
zhongkao.translation: 我们通常在周五下午开每周班会。

grade10.sentence: The scientist writes a weekly column for the magazine about environmental protection.
grade10.translation: 这位科学家每周为杂志写一篇关于环境保护的专栏文章。

definition_en: Relating to real situations and actions rather than ideas; useful and effective.
definition_cn: 实际的；实用的；应用性的

zhongkao.sentence: The teacher gave us some practical advice on how to learn English well.
zhongkao.translation: 老师给了我们一些关于如何学好英语的实用建议。

grade10.sentence: Ideally, students should combine theoretical knowledge with practical experience to solve real-world problems.
grade10.translation: 理想情况下，学生应将理论知识与实践经验相结合来解决现实世界的问题。

definition_en: To attach something to a surface; to persist or continue with a task (stick to).

zhongkao.sentence: Please stick a stamp on the envelope before you mail the letter.
zhongkao.translation: 寄信前请在信封上贴一张邮票。

grade10.sentence: Even though the project was difficult, they decided to stick to the original plan until it was finished.
grade10.translation: 尽管项目很困难，但他们决定坚持原计划直到完成。

definition_en: To be on fire or to produce flames; to damage or hurt something with heat.

zhongkao.sentence: Be careful when you cook, or you might burn your fingers.
zhongkao.translation: 做饭时要小心，否则你可能会烫伤手指。

grade10.sentence: Calories are units of energy that you burn when you exercise.
grade10.translation: 卡路里是你运动时消耗（燃烧）的能量单位。

definition_en: The way in which people or things are arranged; a request for food or goods.

zhongkao.sentence: Please put these books in the correct order on the shelf.
zhongkao.translation: 请把这些书按正确的顺序放在书架上。

grade10.sentence: In order to complete the project on time, the team worked through the night.
grade10.translation: 为了按时完成项目，团队通宵工作。

definition_en: A substance in certain foods, such as fruit, vegetables, and brown bread, that travels through the body as waste and helps digestion.

zhongkao.sentence: Eating vegetables gives you enough fibre to stay healthy.
zhongkao.translation: 吃蔬菜能给你提供足够的纤维素以保持健康。

grade10.sentence: Synthetic fibre is often used in modern clothing because it is durable and cheap.
grade10.translation: 合成纤维因其耐用且便宜，常被用于现代服装中。

definition_en: To have a very strong feeling of wanting something.

zhongkao.sentence: On a hot summer day, I always crave a cold ice cream.
zhongkao.translation: 在炎热的夏日，我总是渴望吃一个凉爽的冰淇淋。

grade10.sentence: Many young people leave their hometowns because they crave the excitement of big city life.
grade10.translation: 许多年轻人离开家乡，因为他们渴望大城市生活的刺激。

definition_en: A standard or level that is considered to be typical or usual.

zhongkao.sentence: The average age of the students in my class is fifteen.
zhongkao.translation: 我们班学生的平均年龄是十五岁。

grade10.sentence: On average, women live longer than men in most countries around the world.
grade10.translation: 平均而言，在世界上大多数国家，女性比男性长寿。

definition_en: The fact that you no longer have something or have less of something.

zhongkao.sentence: He felt very sad about the loss of his favorite watch.
zhongkao.translation: 他对丢失了他最喜欢的手表感到非常难过。

grade10.sentence: The company suffered a significant financial loss due to the bad weather.
grade10.translation: 由于恶劣的天气，这家公司遭受了重大的经济损失。

definition_en: A basic food that is used and needed all the time; a main product or part of something.

zhongkao.sentence: Rice is a staple food for people in southern China.
zhongkao.translation: 米饭是中国南方人的主食。

grade10.sentence: Reading has become a staple part of his daily routine since he started high school.
grade10.translation: 自从上了高中，阅读已成为他日常生活中主要的一部分。

definition_en: Necessary for the success or continued existence of something; extremely important.
definition_cn: 至关重要的；必不可少的；充满活力的

zhongkao.sentence: Water is vital to life, so we must save every drop.
zhongkao.translation: 水对生命至关重要，所以我们必须节约每一滴水。

grade10.sentence: Teamwork plays a vital role in completing this complex project on time.
grade10.translation: 团队合作对于按时完成这个复杂的项目起着至关重要的作用。

definition_en: Substances that plants or animals need in order to live and grow.

zhongkao.sentence: Vegetables provide many nutrients that are good for your health.
zhongkao.translation: 蔬菜提供许多对你健康有益的营养物质。

grade10.sentence: The roots absorb essential nutrients from the soil to help the tree grow strong.
grade10.translation: 树根从土壤中吸收必要的养分以帮助树木长得强壮。

definition_en: Completely necessary; extremely important in a particular situation.
definition_cn: 必不可少的；本质的；基本的

zhongkao.sentence: It is essential to brush your teeth twice a day.
zhongkao.translation: 每天刷两次牙是必不可少的。

grade10.sentence: Effective communication is essential for maintaining a healthy relationship with your classmates.
grade10.translation: 有效的沟通对于维持与同学们的良好关系是必不可少的。

definition_en: To hold something inside or have something as a part.

zhongkao.sentence: This bottle contains milk, so please put it in the fridge.
zhongkao.translation: 这个瓶子里装有牛奶，所以请把它放进冰箱。

grade10.sentence: The document contained confidential information that could not be shared with the public.
grade10.translation: 该文件包含不能向公众分享的机密信息。

definition_en: The amount of something that is used or the act of using it.

zhongkao.sentence: These apples are for local consumption only.
zhongkao.translation: 这些苹果仅供当地食用。

grade10.sentence: The rapid increase in energy consumption has become a major concern for environmentalists.
grade10.translation: 能源消耗的快速增长已成为环保主义者关注的主要问题。

definition_en: Something that allows you to choose; a choice.

zhongkao.sentence: You have two options: walk to school or take the bus.
zhongkao.translation: 你有两个选择：步行去学校或者坐公交车。

grade10.sentence: Taking a gap year is a popular option for students before they start university.
grade10.translation: 在开始上大学之前，休学一年（间隔年）对学生来说是一个受欢迎的选择。

definition_en: A substance found in foods like meat, eggs, and beans that helps your body grow.

zhongkao.sentence: Eggs are a good source of protein for your breakfast.
zhongkao.translation: 鸡蛋是你早餐摄取蛋白质的良好来源。

grade10.sentence: A balanced diet should include adequate protein to support muscle repair and immune function.
grade10.translation: 均衡的饮食应包含足够的蛋白质，以支持肌肉修复和免疫功能。

definition_en: A substance produced by or used in chemistry.

zhongkao.sentence: The teacher showed us a chemical change in the science lab.
zhongkao.translation: 老师在科学实验室给我们展示了一个化学变化。

grade10.sentence: Farmers are trying to reduce the use of harsh chemicals on their crops.
grade10.translation: 农民们正试图减少在农作物上使用强效化学物质。

definition_en: To break down food in the stomach so the body can use it; also to understand information.

zhongkao.sentence: Vegetables are usually easier to digest than meat.
zhongkao.translation: 蔬菜通常比肉类更容易消化。

grade10.sentence: She needed some quiet time to digest the surprising news she had just heard.
grade10.translation: 她需要一些安静的时间来消化她刚刚听到的惊人消息。

definition_en: A large natural or artificial lake used as a source of water supply.

zhongkao.sentence: The city gets its drinking water from a nearby reservoir.
zhongkao.translation: 这座城市的饮用水来自附近的一个水库。

grade10.sentence: During the dry season, the water level in the reservoir dropped significantly.
grade10.translation: 在旱季，水库的水位显著下降。

definition_en: In large quantities; very clearly or plentifully.
definition_cn: 丰富地；大量地；十分清楚

zhongkao.sentence: Wild flowers grow abundantly in this field during spring.
zhongkao.translation: 春天里，这片田野上野花盛开。

grade10.sentence: The teacher made it abundantly clear that cheating would not be tolerated.
grade10.translation: 老师十分清楚地表明，绝不容忍作弊行为。

definition_en: A chemical element found in bones and teeth, essential for life.

zhongkao.sentence: Milk contains calcium and phosphorus which help make bones strong.
zhongkao.translation: 牛奶含有钙和磷，有助于骨骼强壮。

grade10.sentence: Phosphorus is a vital mineral that plays a major role in the development of healthy body cells.
grade10.translation: 磷是一种至关重要的矿物质，在健康体细胞的发育中起着主要作用。

definition_en: A natural substance found in food that is necessary to keep your body healthy.

zhongkao.sentence: Oranges are famous for containing a lot of Vitamin C.
zhongkao.translation: 橙子以含有大量的维生素C而闻名。

grade10.sentence: A balanced diet usually provides all the essential vitamins required for the body to function properly.
grade10.translation: 均衡的饮食通常能提供身体正常运作所需的所有必需维生素。

definition_en: Connected with something or taking part in an activity.

zhongkao.sentence: He was involved in the school play and practiced every day.
zhongkao.translation: 他参与了学校的戏剧表演，并且每天都在练习。

grade10.sentence: The police are investigating the people involved in the car accident.
grade10.translation: 警方正在调查卷入这起车祸的人员。

definition_en: A series of actions that you take in order to achieve a result.

zhongkao.sentence: Learning a new language is a slow process.
zhongkao.translation: 学习一门新语言是一个缓慢的过程。

grade10.sentence: The manufacturing process has been automated to increase efficiency.
grade10.translation: 制造流程已经自动化以提高效率。

definition_en: The smallest unit of living matter that can exist on its own.
definition_cn: 细胞；（监狱的）单人牢房；电池

zhongkao.sentence: Our teacher showed us a plant cell under the microscope.
zhongkao.translation: 老师在显微镜下给我们展示了一个植物细胞。

grade10.sentence: Scientists are studying how cancer cells grow and spread.
grade10.translation: 科学家们正在研究癌细胞是如何生长和扩散的。

definition_en: The power and ability to be physically and mentally active.

zhongkao.sentence: You should sleep early to save energy for tomorrow's hike.
zhongkao.translation: 你应该早点睡，为明天的徒步旅行积蓄精力。

grade10.sentence: The world is facing a crisis due to the shortage of traditional energy sources.
grade10.translation: 由于传统能源的短缺，世界正面临危机。

definition_en: The process of making or growing goods to be sold.

zhongkao.sentence: This factory is famous for the production of glass.
zhongkao.translation: 这家工厂以生产玻璃而闻名。

grade10.sentence: Mass production lowered the cost of cars significantly in the 20th century.
grade10.translation: 大规模生产在20世纪显著降低了汽车的成本。

definition_en: To use something up (like fuel, energy, or time) or to eat/drink something.

zhongkao.sentence: The heavy truck consumed a lot of oil on the long journey.
zhongkao.translation: 那辆重型卡车在长途旅行中消耗了大量的油。

grade10.sentence: Creating this artwork consumed all of his spare time for three months.
grade10.translation: 创作这件艺术品耗费了他三个月来所有的业余时间。

definition_en: Past tense of digest: to break down food in the stomach, or to understand and think about new information.
definition_cn: 消化（食物）；领会，理解（信息）

zhongkao.sentence: He waited until he had digested his food before going for a swim.
zhongkao.translation: 他等到食物消化后才去游泳。

grade10.sentence: She sat quietly as she digested the complex information from the lecture.
grade10.translation: 她静静地坐着，消化着讲座中复杂的那些信息。

definition_en: To take in or soak up (energy, liquid, or other substances); to take in information.

zhongkao.sentence: Plants absorb water and sunlight to grow well.
zhongkao.translation: 植物通过吸收水分和阳光来茁壮成长。

grade10.sentence: It is important for students to learn how to absorb knowledge effectively in class.
grade10.translation: 对于学生来说，学会如何在课堂上有效地吸收知识是很重要的。

question: 1. A. drink B. diet C. eat D. chew
analysis: A、C、D项均为表示具体动作（喝、吃、咀嚼）的动词，B项diet通常指“日常饮食”或“节食”，侧重于名词概念，故选B。

question: 2. A. lost B. weight C. exercise D. visit
analysis: B、C、D项均可作为名词或动词的原形，而A项lost是动词lose的过去式/过去分词或形容词，词形与词性与其他三项不同，故选A。

question: 3. A. supermarket B. gym C. shop D. store
analysis: A、C、D项均为购物场所（超市、商店），B项gym为健身场所，语义类别不同，故选B。

question: 4. A. lean B. benefit C. fit D. healthy
analysis: A、C、D项均为形容词，常用来描述身体健康状况，B项benefit意为“益处”，通常作名词或动词，词性不同，故选B。

question: 5. A. daily B. weekly C. practical D. stick
analysis: A、B、C项均为形容词，D项stick通常作动词（坚持、粘贴）或名词，词性不同，故选D。

question: I must ______ your pardon.
analysis: 句意为：我必须恳求您的原谅。"crave your pardon" 是正式英语中请求原谅的表达。

question: Plants draw minerals and other ______ from the soil.
analysis: 句意为：植物从土壤中吸收矿物质和其他养分。"nutrients" 意为营养物质，符合语境。

question: People had to ______ these trees to keep warm during harsh winters.
analysis: 句意为：在严酷的冬天，人们不得不烧树来取暖。根据 "keep warm"（保暖）可知需要燃烧树木，故填 "burn"。

question: Reading is of ______ importance in language learning.
analysis: 句意为：阅读在语言学习中至关重要。"of vital importance" 是固定短语，意为“至关重要”。

question: High ______ diets give the feeling of fullness.
analysis: 句意为：高纤维饮食能给人饱腹感。"high fibre diets" 指高纤维饮食，常识上纤维有助于产生饱腹感。

question: All the procedures must be done in the correct ______
analysis: 句意为：所有程序必须按正确的顺序执行。"in the correct order" 是常用搭配，意为“按正确的顺序”。

question: It is well-known that bamboo shoots are a panda's ______ diet.
analysis: 句意为：众所周知，竹笋是熊猫的主食。"staple diet" 意为“主食”。

question: 400 people a year die of this disease on ______
analysis: 句意为：平均每年有400人死于这种疾病。"on average" 是固定搭配，意为“平均”。

question: Nothing can make up for the ______ of a child.
analysis: 句意为：没有什么能弥补失去孩子的痛苦。"make up for the loss" 意为“弥补损失”或“弥补失去……的缺憾”。

analysis: n. 化学物质；adj. 化学的

analysis: v. 消化；吸收；领会

analysis: n. 水库；蓄水池；储备

question: Calcium is found most a______ in milk.
analysis: 这句话的意思是：牛奶中钙的含量最为丰富。根据首字母 'a' 和语境，这里需要一个副词来修饰 found，abundantly 意为'丰富地'，符合题意。

question: These include calcium, p______ and other minerals and vitamins.
analysis: 这句话的意思是：这些包括钙、磷以及其他矿物质和维生素。根据首字母 'p' 和并列提到的 calcium (钙)，此处指化学元素 phosphorus (磷)。

question: Oranges are rich in v______ C.
analysis: 这句话的意思是：橙子富含维生素C。固定搭配 vitamin C，首字母 'v' 符合 vitamin (维生素)。

question: Many of the crimes i______ drugs.
analysis: 这句话的意思是：许多犯罪活动都涉及毒品。根据主语 crimes 和首字母 'i'，动词 involve (涉及、包含) 符合语境。

question: The whole p______ started all over again.
analysis: 这句话的意思是：整个过程又重新开始了。根据定冠词 the 和首字母 'p'，名词 process (过程、程序) 符合语境。

question: The c______ is the unit of which all living organisms are composed.
analysis: 这句话的意思是：细胞是构成所有生物体的单位。根据生物学定义和首字母 'c'，单词 cell (细胞) 符合语境。

question: She's always full of e______.
analysis: 这句话的意思是：她总是充满活力。短语 be full of energy 意为'精力充沛'，首字母 'e' 符合 energy (精力、活力)。

question: The whole company are working hard to improve the p______ of the new machine.
analysis: 这句话的意思是：全公司都在努力提高新机器的性能。improve the performance 意为'提高性能'，首字母 'p' 符合 performance (性能、表现)。

article:
Around the world, eggs have been a breakfast staple for all good reasons. After all, an egg is a storehouse of vital nutrients, making it an essential part of a healthy diet. And for those who are afraid of having this high-energy food because you're worried that it will add to your weight, remember, one egg [1] about 80 calories and about five grams of fat. Hence, smart consumption is a far healthier option.

Eggs are a well-known rich source of [2] —an important building block of bones, muscles, skin, and blood. The body uses protein to build and repair tissues as well as making other body chemicals. Unfortunately, unlike fat and carbohydrates, the body does not store protein, and therefore has no reservoir to draw on when it needs a new supply. Thus, eggs are the perfect sources and a smart food choice for those who reduce their intake of carbohydrates to lose extra weight.

Another important nutrient that is found [3] in egg white is riboflavin or vitamin B2. And for those who are wondering about the benefit of this nutrient, riboflavin is a water-soluble vitamin that is [4] in vital processes in the body and is necessary for normal cell function, growth, and energy [5]

The yolk, which many people avoid out of fear, is actually very healthy, if [6] in moderation. Mainly made up of fat, there are only 1.33 grams of cholesterol per 100 grams of yolk. In addition, the yolk is a rich source of vitamin A, B vitamins, calcium, phosphorus and iron. Incidentally, the iron found in the yolk is easily [7] in the body. According to nutrition experts, one can eat one whole egg every day without harming one's cholesterol and blood fat levels. However, for those who crave more eggs, you can reduce fat by having one whole egg and only the whites of the rest of the eggs.

questions.analysis: 这句话缺少谓语动词。主语 'one egg'（一个鸡蛋）后面应该接动词说明其成分。'Contains'（包含）符合语境，即一个鸡蛋包含约80卡路里。
根据破折号后的解释 'an important building block of bones, muscles...'（骨骼、肌肉的重要构建成分），以及后文中提到的 'The body uses protein...'，可知此处指鸡蛋是 'protein'（蛋白质）的丰富来源。
此处需要一个副词来修饰动词 'found'。'Abundantly' 意为丰富地、大量地，符合句意，指核黄素大量存在于蛋清中。
考查固定搭配 'be involved in'，意为“参与/涉及”。句意指这种维生素参与了身体的重要过程。
此处需要一个名词与前面的 'function' 和 'growth' 并列。'Energy production' 是固定搭配，意为“能量产生”或“能量代谢”。
这里是状语从句的省略结构 'if it is consumed'。需要使用过去分词表示被动含义。'Consumed' 意为“食用/消耗”，句意为“如果适量食用”。
句子结构为被动语态 'is easily [done]'。选项A是原形，C也是原形且语意不通。只有B 'digested'（被消化）是过去分词形式，符合语法结构。
